lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਕਲੀ ਸਦੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raamakalee sad ||
lines.translation: Raamkalee, Sadd ~ The Call Of Death:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jag daataa soi bhagat vachhal tihu loi jeeu ||
lines.translation: He is the Great Giver of the Universe, the Lover of His devotees, throughout the three worlds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur sabad samaavae avar na jaanai koi jeeu ||
lines.translation: One who is merged in the Word of the Guru's Shabad does not know any other.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਵਰੋ ਨ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: avaro na jaanahi sabad gur kai ek naam dhiaavahe ||
lines.translation: Dwelling upon the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he does not know any other; he meditates on the One Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਅੰਗਦ ਪਰਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਪਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: parasaad naanak guroo a(n)gad param padavee paavahe ||
lines.translation: By the Grace of Guru Nanak and Guru Angad, Guru Amar Das obtained the supreme status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇਆ ਹਕਾਰਾ ਚਲਣਵਾਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: aaiaa hakaaraa chalanavaaraa har raam naam samaaiaa ||
lines.translation: And when the call came for Him to depart, He merged in the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਗਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਤੋਲੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jag amar atal atol thaakur bhagat te har paaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: Through devotional worship in this world, the imperishable, immovable, immeasurable Lord is found. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhaanaa gur bhaaiaa gur jaavai har prabh paas jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Guru gladly accepted the Lord's Will, and so the Guru easily reached the Lord God's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kare har pahi benatee meree paij rakhahu aradaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: The True Guru prays to the Lord, "Please, save my honor. This is my prayer".

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਹ ਕੇਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: paij raakhahu har janah keree har dehu naam nira(n)jano ||
lines.translation: Please save the honor of Your humble servant, O Lord; please bless him with Your Immaculate Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਿ ਚਲਦਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਬੇਲੀ ਜਮਦੂਤ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਖੰਜਨੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)t chaladiaa hoi belee jamadoot kaal nikha(n)jano ||
lines.translation: At this time of final departure, it is our only help and support; it destroys death, and the Messenger of Death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਪਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: satiguroo kee benatee paaee har prabh sunee aradaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Lord God heard the prayer of the True Guru, and granted His request.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har dhaar kirapaa satigur milaaiaa dhan dhan kahai saabaas jeeu ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord showered His Mercy, and blended the True Guru with Himself; He said, "Blessed! Blessed! Wonderful!" ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈਹੋ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਆਉ ਮੈ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere sikh sunahu put bhaaeeho merai har bhaanaa aau mai paas jeeu ||
lines.translation: Listen O my Sikhs, my children and Siblings of Destiny; it is my Lord's Will that I must now go to Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਇਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhaanaa gur bhaaiaa meraa har prabh kare saabaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Guru gladly accepted the Lord's Will, and my Lord God applauded Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੋਈ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat satigur purakh soee jis har prabh bhaanaa bhaavae ||
lines.translation: One who is pleased with the Lord God's Will is a devotee, the True Guru, the Primal Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਨੰਦ ਅਨਹਦ ਵਜਹਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਗਲਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: aana(n)d anahad vajahi vaaje har aap gal melaavae ||
lines.translation: The unstruck sound current of bliss resounds and vibrates; the Lord hugs him close in His embrace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਸੀ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਨਿਰਜਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tusee put bhaaee paravaar meraa man vekhahu kar nirajaas jeeu ||
lines.translation: O my children, siblings and family, look carefully in your minds, and see.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਫਿਰੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: dhur likhiaa paravaanaa phirai naahee gur jaai har prabh paas jeeu ||3||
lines.translation: The pre-ordained death warrant cannot be avoided; the Guru is going to be with the Lord God. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਬਹਿ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਸਦਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bhaanai aapanai bahi paravaar sadaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru, in His Own Sweet Will, sat up and summoned His family.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਕੋਈ ਰੋਵਸੀ ਸੋ ਮੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat mai pichhai koee rovasee so mai mool na bhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Let no one weep for me after I am gone. That would not please me at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤੁ ਪੈਝੈ ਮਿਤੁ ਬਿਗਸੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਤ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: mit paijhai mit bigasai jis mit kee paij bhaavae ||
lines.translation: When a friend receives a robe of honor, then his friends are pleased with his honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਸੀ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪੈਨਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tusee veechaar dekhahu put bhaaee har satiguroo painaavae ||
lines.translation: Consider this and see, O my children and siblings; the Lord has given the True Guru the robe of supreme honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਰਤਖਿ ਹੋਦੈ ਬਹਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਆਪਿ ਟਿਕਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satiguroo paratakh hodai bahi raaj aap tikaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The True Guru Himself sat up, and appointed the successor to the Throne of Raja Yoga, the Yoga of Meditation and Success.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਸਿਖ ਬੰਧਪ ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: sabh sikh ba(n)dhap put bhaaee raamadaas pairee paaiaa ||4||
lines.translation: All the Sikhs, relatives, children and siblings have fallen at the Feet of Guru Ram Das. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਮੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਿਅਹੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)te satigur boliaa mai pichhai keeratan kariahu nirabaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: Finally, the True Guru said, "When I am gone, sing Kirtan in Praise of the Lord, in Nirvaanaa."

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੇਸੋ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਸਦਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: keso gopaal pa(n)dit sadiahu har har kathaa paRahi puraan jeeu ||
lines.translation: Call in the long-haired scholarly Saints of the Lord, to read the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਪੜੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਬੇਬਾਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kathaa paReeai har naam suneeai bebaan har ra(n)g gur bhaavae ||
lines.translation: Read the sermon of the Lord, and listen to the Lord's Name; the Guru is pleased with love for the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਦੀਵਾ ਫੁਲ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਿ ਪਾਵਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: pi(n)d patal kiriaa deevaa phul har sar paavae ||
lines.translation: Do not bother with offering rice-balls on leaves, lighting lamps, and other rituals like floating the body out on the Ganges; instead, let my remains be given up to the Lord's Pool.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸੁਜਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhaaiaa satigur boliaa har miliaa purakh sujaan jeeu ||
lines.translation: The Lord was pleased as the True Guru spoke; he was blended then with the all-knowing Primal Lord God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮਦਾਸ ਸੋਢੀ ਤਿਲਕੁ ਦੀਆ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸਚੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: raamadaas sodhee tilak deeaa gurasabad sach neesaan jeeu ||5||
lines.translation: The Guru then blessed the Sodhi Ram Das with the ceremonial tilak mark, the insignia of the True Word of the Shabad. ||5||
